title: Candid
summary: CANDID, adjective 1. White. 2. Fair; open; frank; ingenuous; free from undue bias; disposed to think and judge according to truth and justice, or without partiality or prejudice; applied to persons. 3

inlines.v: CANDID, adjective 1. White. 2. Fair; open; frank; ingenuous; free from undue bias; disposed to think and judge according to truth and justice, or without partiality or prejudice; applied to persons. 3. Fair; just; impartial; applied to things; as a candid view, or construction.
